title: Yummy Chewy Ukrainian Peas Stew
description: A resinous, chewy Ukrainian stew with yellow split peas, smoked pork, and aromatic vegetables.
instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas under cold water until running clear, then place them in a pot with 8 cups of water and bring to a boil; let them simmer for 5 minutes to blanch, then drain and set aside.
In the same pot, add the cubed smoked pork belly and sauté for 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the chopped carrot, diced onion, and minced garlic to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables soften.
Stir in the blanched peas, 8 cups of water, bay leaf, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender and the stew thickens.
Remove the bay leaf, and mash a portion of the peas against the side of the pot with a spoon to create a creamy, resinous texture.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper if needed, then stir in chopped dill for freshness.
Ladle the hot-pea stew into bowls and serve immediately, letting the steam create a chewy, indulgent experience.
